name: Clovoxamine
summary: Clovoxamine (INN; development code DU-23811) is a drug that was discovered in the 1970s and was subsequently investigated as an antidepressant and anxiolytic agent but was never marketed. It acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI), with little affinity for the muscarinic acetylcholine, histamine, adrenergic, and serotonin receptors. The compound is structurally related to fluvoxamine.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI), with little affinity for the muscarinic acetylcholine, histamine, adrenergic, and serotonin receptors.

uses.text: Clovoxamine (INN; development code DU-23811) is a drug that was discovered in the 1970s and was subsequently investigated as an antidepressant and anxiolytic agent but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that block serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake can cause nausea, sweating, sleep problems, raised blood pressure and sexual problems, and at high levels serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。阻斷血清素與正腎上腺素回收的藥物可能造成噁心、出汗、睡眠問題、血壓升高與性功能問題，濃度過高時可能引發血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。阻断血清素与正肾上腺素回收的药物可能造成恶心、出汗、睡眠问题、血压升高与性功能问题，浓度过高时可能引发血清素症候群。

fact.en: Clovoxamine is a close relative of the antidepressant fluvoxamine, made by the same Dutch company, Duphar. It has a chlorine atom where fluvoxamine has a trifluoromethyl group.
fact.zh: Clovoxamine 是抗憂鬱藥氟伏沙明的近親，由同一家荷蘭公司杜法（Duphar）研發。氟伏沙明帶三氟甲基的位置，它換成了氯原子。
fact.zhHans: Clovoxamine 是抗忧郁药氟伏沙明的近亲，由同一家荷兰公司杜法（Duphar）研发。氟伏沙明带三氟甲基的位置，它换成了氯原子。
